facts.fact: Clara Cottage 公用电话响；初来她从不接，只偶尔打给匹兹堡父母；隔楼板铃响都惊跳
来电 Ruth Lachoff——从了夫姓；因「读学位期间怀孕」被导师判入湮没
facts.anchor: the audacity of becoming pregnant while dissertating
facts.verbatim: the audacity of becoming pregnant while dissertating

facts.fact: 上次见面在 Winn-Dixie，她约午餐、连珠炮问项目/文章/计划；Joan 出于可怜分享申请清单
Ruth 提追悼会（就在周末）你没去；她称「他是个独特的人」
facts.anchor: you weren’t at the memorial service
facts.verbatim: you weren’t at the memorial service

facts.fact: 她捕捉到谨慎暗流：「有些人在问你人在哪」；「他弟弟和教务长来清空了他的办公室」
facts.anchor: His brother and the dean came and cleared out his office
facts.verbatim: His brother and the dean came and cleared out his office

facts.fact: Joan 眼都没眨、冰冷的平静稳住发抖的手指：他们在那儿找不到任何东西
facts.anchor: They wouldn’t find a thing in there.
facts.verbatim: They wouldn’t find a thing in there.

facts.fact: Ruth 庇护式叮嘱：我没告诉任何人你在哪；你不需要被拖回那些事；最好留在原地
facts.anchor: I didn’t tell anyone where you were
facts.verbatim: I didn’t tell anyone where you were

facts.fact: 她顺水推舟「不会回新奥尔良」；线路先挂，她对着拨号音说了句惊呆的告别
facts.anchor: I don’t think I’ll be back to New Orleans for a while.
facts.verbatim: I don’t think I’ll be back to New Orleans for a while.
